senses.gloss:
añjalihasta
(‘with folded hands’)
------------------------------------------
In the Indian iconographical works several mudrās or hastas, poses of the hand, are described for images. Each one of these indicates a particular feeling or sentiment.
In the अञ्जलिहस्त, the two hands of the image are folded, leaving a hollow between them. The hands thus folded rest on the chest and are kept parallel to the ground.
This pose indicates salutation.
